subtitle: Out Manila · Cebu Pacific
overview: Fly Cebu Pacific from Manila to Hanoi and head straight up to Sapa for two nights in a 4★ hotel. Ride the mountain railway and cable car to Fansipan, stroll Cat Cat Village, then return to Hanoi for an egg coffee and your last night before the flight home. A private coach and an English-speaking guide stay with you throughout.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Apr 15–18 2027 to May 27–30 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Hoan Kiem Lake: A scenic lake in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter, with the red Huc Bridge and Ngoc Son Temple.
placeDesc.Fansipan: The highest peak in Indochina near Sapa, reached on this tour by one-way train and cable car.
placeDesc.Muong Hoa Mountain Railway: A scenic mountain funicular train in Sapa that takes visitors up the valley toward the Fansipan cable car.
placeDesc.Moana Sapa: A resort-style leisure and photo attraction in Sapa visited on the Day 2 sightseeing.
placeDesc.Cat Cat Village: A traditional Hmong village near Sapa known for its terraced hillside, waterfall and handicrafts.
placeDesc.Lao Cai Border Gate: The international border gate administration center at Lao Cai on the Vietnam–China border, visited on the way to Hanoi.
placeDesc.Egg coffee: Hanoi's famous specialty drink of strong coffee topped with creamy whipped egg, enjoyed on this tour.
